answer: A payout is split so that 39% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The garden schedule is applied in ledge and ferrous shows each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3175 identities would post 2546 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
